# KRONATRIX — canonical website and service directory

Last updated: 18 August 2026

## What KRONATRIX is
KRONATRIX is an AI search visibility and website business focused on making public business information easier for people, search engines and AI-powered search systems to discover, understand and verify.

## Main authority website
https://kronatrix.co.uk/

Core topics are consolidated on the parent domain rather than being maintained as separate long-term topic authority subdomains.

## Honest positioning
No ethical provider can guarantee a Google ranking, indexation, ChatGPT mention, Gemini recommendation or AI citation. KRONATRIX focuses on controllable signals such as entity clarity, useful content, evidence, crawlability, architecture, metadata, accurate structured data, internal linking, page experience and conversion clarity.

## llms.txt note
Google Search currently states that llms.txt and special AI text files are not required for its generative AI features and do not improve Google Search visibility. These KRONATRIX text files are maintained only as optional machine-readable directories for systems that may choose to use them.
